name: MessageBird
tagline: SMS, voice, and omnichannel messaging APIs for global customer communication.
description: MessageBird (now part of Bird) provides REST APIs for SMS, MMS, voice calling/messaging, conversations (WhatsApp, etc.), email, and number management. Developers authenticate with AccessKey headers against rest.messagebird.com and related service hosts to send messages, check balance, and manage communications programmatically.

auth.details: API access key via Authorization: AccessKey {accessKey} header. Create keys in MessageBird Dashboard (test_ prefix for test keys; live keys have no required prefix). Self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Pay-as-you-go starts free (no card for trial usage); SMS billed per message by destination after credits. Exact free SMS allotment not clearly published on legacy MessageBird pricing—Bird email free tier is 1,000 emails/month (50/day cap). Treat free SMS as limited trial/credits; confirm in dashboard.
pricing.paid_plans: Usage-based SMS/voice by destination country; Bird also offers Startup/Growth email volume plans and enterprise channel bundles. Contact sales for volume SMS discounts.

rate_limits: SMS/REST API: GET/PATCH/DELETE 50 req/s, POST 500 req/s; excess returns 429. Contact support for higher limits. Newer Bird Channels API: GET 50 req/s, POST 500 req/s per workspace.
use_cases: send SMS OTP or alert to a phone number
check account balance and remaining credits
send and track omnichannel conversation messages (WhatsApp/SMS)
purchase or list virtual phone numbers
list SMS message status and delivery reports
